name: Fighting Sports
teaser: Combat disciplines ranging from boxing to MMA, judo to taekwondo. The UFC, founded in 1993, grew MMA from a niche spectacle into a $1.5 billion industry. Bruce Lee's philosophy of 'no way as way' influenced modern mixed martial arts training.

name: Water Sports
teaser: Activities on or in water from swimming to surfing to rowing. Surfing was Polynesian royalty's exclusive sport for centuries before becoming mainstream. The 2020 Olympics added surfing, skateboarding, and sport climbing to attract younger viewers.

name: Mind Sports
teaser: Competitive activities emphasizing mental skill — chess, Go, bridge, esports. Garry Kasparov's 1997 loss to Deep Blue was a landmark for AI. Chess viewership surged 300% during Netflix's 'The Queen's Gambit' in 2020.

name: Extreme Sports
teaser: High-risk activities like BASE jumping, wingsuit flying, and big wave surfing. Kelly Slater's 20-foot wave in 2022 pushed surfing's limits. Felix Baumgartner's 2012 space jump from 39km reached Mach 1.25 in freefall.

name: Fantasy Sports
teaser: Virtual competitions where participants build teams from real players and score points based on statistics. Fantasy football alone generates $14 billion annually in entry fees. Over 45 million Americans play fantasy sports.

name: Olympic History
teaser: The ancient Games ran from 776 BCE to 393 CE in Olympia, Greece. The modern Olympics, revived by Pierre de Coubertin in 1896, now feature 10,500 athletes across 33 sports. The 2024 Paris Games will be the first to achieve gender parity.

name: Sports Medicine
teaser: The field treating and preventing sports injuries. ACL reconstruction surgery has a 90% success rate. Cryotherapy, compression therapy, and progressive loading protocols have reduced athlete recovery times by 40% over the past two decades.

name: Records and Milestones
teaser: Unbreakable or nearly unbreakable sports records. Usain Bolt's 9.58-second 100m may stand for decades. Wilt Chamberlain's 100-point basketball game in 1962 remains the highest single-game scoring record in NBA history.

name: Team Sports Dynamics
teaser: How teams form, perform, and evolve. The 'hot hand' fallacy — that streaks in basketball are real — was long debunked but a 2015 study found slight evidence for it. Team chemistry is difficult to quantify but consistently predicts success.

name: Motor Sports
teaser: Racing disciplines from Formula 1 to NASCAR to rally. F1 cars generate 1,500 horsepower and reach 370km/h. The Monaco Grand Prix has been run since 1929. Ayrton Senna's 1984 Monaco lap in the rain is considered the greatest single lap in racing history.

name: Historical Athletes
teaser: Athletes who transcended their sport. Jesse Owens won four gold medals at the 1936 Berlin Olympics, defying Hitler's Aryan supremacy ideology. Muhammad Ali's refusal to serve in Vietnam in 1967 cost him his title but cemented his legacy beyond boxing.

name: Ball Sports
teaser: Any sport involving a ball — soccer, basketball, cricket, tennis, golf. Soccer's FIFA World Cup 2022 final between Argentina and France was watched by 1.5 billion people. The Cricket World Cup 2023 final drew 1.2 billion viewers in India alone.

name: Combat Sports Training
teaser: The methodology behind fighting disciplines. Muay Thai fighters in Thailand begin training at age 7. Boxing's 'heavy bag' training develops power while 'speed bag' work builds hand-eye coordination. MMA fighters typically cross-train in 3-4 disciplines.

name: Winter Sports
teaser: Activities on snow and ice from skiing to curling. Skiing originated 8,000 years ago in Scandinavia. Bobsled was invented in the Swiss Alps in the 1860s. The Winter Olympics have been held since 1924 and now feature 15 sports.

name: Racket Sports
teaser: Tennis, badminton, squash, table tennis, and pickleball. Badminton's shuttlecock can reach 493km/h — the fastest racket sport speed. Pickleball grew 85% in 2022, becoming America's fastest-growing sport. Wimbledon's grass court is perennial rye.

name: Track and Field
teaser: Athletics events from sprinting to throwing to jumping. The decathlon combines 10 events over two days. Usain Bolt's 9.58 100m record at the 2009 Berlin World Championships is considered one of sport's most untouchable records.

name: Sports Governance
teaser: Organizations that regulate and manage sports. FIFA, founded in 1904, has 211 member nations — more than the UN. The IOC's Olympic Charter defines Olympism's philosophy. Doping scandals have tested sports governance repeatedly since Ben Johnson's 1988 disqualification.

name: Youth Development
teaser: Systems for identifying and nurturing young athletes. La Masia, Barcelona's academy, produced Messi, Xavi, and Iniesta. The US college sports system feeds professional leagues. Early sport specialization vs multi-sport participation is actively debated.

name: Referee and Officiating
teaser: The evolving role of officials in sports. VAR (Video Assistant Referee) in soccer was introduced at the 2018 World Cup. Hawk-Eye line-calling in tennis uses seven cameras to track ball position within 3.6mm. Officiating errors remain a source of controversy.

name: Training Science
teaser: Evidence-based approaches to athletic performance. Periodization — cycling training intensity — was developed by Soviet scientists in the 1960s. High-altitude training increases red blood cell count. VO2 max testing measures aerobic fitness ceiling.

name: Esports Competitive
teaser: Organized competitive video gaming. League of Legends World Championship 2023 drew 6.4 million concurrent viewers. The average pro gamer practices 10-12 hours daily. Esports scholarships are offered by 200+ US colleges.

name: Sports Technology
teaser: Innovations improving performance and officiating. Carbon fiber running shoes with embedded plates improved marathon times by 4% — World Athletics regulated them in 2020. Hawkeye, instant replay, and GPS tracking have transformed how sports are played and officied.

name: Cycling Endurance
teaser: Road cycling races like the Tour de France cover 3,500km over 23 stages. Lance Armstrong's seven titles were stripped for doping. Eddy Merckx holds the record with five Tour victories. The sport averages 40km/h over three weeks of racing.

name: Professional Wrestling
teaser: Scripted athletic entertainment combining acrobatics, storytelling, and improvisation. WWE, the largest promotion, runs 500+ events annually. The Undertaker's WrestleMania streak of 21-0 lasted from 1991 to 2014. Japanese puroresu emphasizes stiff, realistic strikes.

name: Traditional Sports
teaser: Indigenous and cultural games worldwide. Kabaddi, popular in South Asia, requires a 'raider' to tag opponents while holding their breath. Mesoamerican ballgame, played since 1400 BCE, sometimes ended in human sacrifice. Capoeira blends martial arts with dance.
